purpose: Close the first direct three-wire fanout question left by the Boolean q normal form. Exhaust every source-open cross-wire matching gadget on three copies of the explicit smooth twisted wire through six physical splice edges and prove that none projects to ALL_EQ_3(qA,qB,qC). Then give an explicit seven-edge source-open gadget whose exact q projection is ALL_EQ_3. Since a reusable three-output fanout that leaves at least two dangling Hamiltonian ports on every named wire can use at most six splice edges, the seven-edge logical threshold is already beyond the physical composability budget.

model.local_state: (c,s,q) with c in GF(3), s in {+1,-1}, q in {+1,-1}, using the exact v8.2 boundary formulas.
model.splice: A physical splice edge joins one unused dangling port of one wire to one unused dangling port of another wire and imposes colour inequality. Ports are used at most once.
model.source_open_gate: The union of the three wires' nine internal H paths and selected splice edges must contain no closed Hamiltonian component; equivalently the kept H subgraph remains a forest of open paths.

symmetry_reduction.statement: For each fixed q triple, global colour relabelling is the affine S3 action x -> alpha*x+beta on GF(3), alpha in {+1,-1}. It acts freely and transitively on one wire's six (c,s) frames. Therefore fix wire A to cA=0,sA=+1 without loss and enumerate only the 6*6=36 frames of wires B,C.
symmetry_reduction.effect: Every q-assignment satisfiability set is represented by one 36-bit mask. Adding a splice edge is exact bitwise intersection with its precomputed mask. No colour assignment is approximated or dropped.

exhaustive_minimality_search.edge_universe: 108 possible cross-wire edges: three unordered wire pairs times 6 times 6 endpoint ports.
exhaustive_minimality_search.enumeration: Depth-first in increasing edge id, so every matching edge set is visited exactly once. Maintain exact open-path endpoint pairing; adding an edge between the two endpoints of one existing path is rejected because it would close an H cycle. Maintain the eight exact 36-bit q masks and prune only when one of the two required all-equal q assignments has already become impossible, which cannot remove an ALL_EQ_3 witness.
exhaustive_minimality_search.result: No visited source-open matching through k=6 has exact q relation ALL_EQ_3. Because every candidate ALL_EQ_3 gadget must preserve both all-equal assignments, the target-preserving DFS is exhaustive for the claim.

seven_edge_witness.meaning: The Boolean equality-of-three relation is physically realizable in this direct language, but only after crossing the reusable three-output port budget. The witness distinguishes a genuine capacity obstruction from a purely logical non-definability obstruction.

capacity_corollary.reusable_interface_requirement: Demand at least two unused dangling Hamiltonian ports on each of A,B,C after the fanout gadget, so each named copy can still be spliced into later source-open logic.
capacity_corollary.counting_bound: Each wire has six dangling ports, hence can spend at most four. Across three wires at most 12 port incidences can be consumed, i.e. at most six splice edges.
capacity_corollary.theorem: No direct three-wire source-open ALL_EQ_3 fanout with at least two residual dangling ports on every terminal exists in this matching language.
capacity_corollary.proof: Any such reusable gadget has k<=6 by the incidence count, while the exhaustive exact search proves ALL_EQ_3 absent for every source-open matching through k=6.

main_theorem.name: DIRECT_Q_ALL_EQ3_NEEDS_SEVEN_SPLICES_AND_THEREFORE_EXCEEDS_THREE_OUTPUT_CAPACITY
main_theorem.statement: Within the direct three-wire cross-splice matching language of v8.2, source-open ALL_EQ_3 has minimum splice size seven. Consequently no such direct ALL_EQ_3 gadget can retain two or more dangling ports on each of its three named wires; direct reusable Boolean fanout is impossible in this language.
main_theorem.firewall: Minimum seven is scoped to exactly three copies of the explicit twisted wire, cross-wire matching edges only, and the source-open no-internal-H-cycle gate. Auxiliary wires, larger gadgets, or interfaces exposing different ports remain open.

positive: Turns the v8.2 direct-EQ critical-port observation into a complete three-output direct fanout barrier rather than a single-gadget failure.
Shows that q equality itself is not logically missing: it appears exactly at seven direct splice edges; the obstruction is reusable Hamiltonian port capacity.
Provides a tiny explicit seven-edge ALL_EQ_3 control for every future auxiliary-wire construction.
killed: Search longer within the same three-wire direct matching language for a reusable ALL_EQ_3 fanout with at least two free ports per output.
Assume that combining the direct q-EQ/implication atoms on only the three named wires will eventually evade the six-port budget without auxiliary structure.
not_killed: Auxiliary-wire fanout in which hidden wires absorb the seven-edge equality burden while named terminals retain external ports.
A variable-consistency backbone using implications plus clause gadgets without literal three-way ALL_EQ_3.
A polynomial algorithm exploiting the same capacity invariant.

next_target.name: E8_AUXILIARY_WIRE_Q_FANOUT_OR_CONSISTENCY_BACKBONE_V8_4
next_target.directive: Stop searching the direct three-wire matching language: v8.3 closes it. Add one or more auxiliary twisted wires and search source-open gadgets whose named terminals retain at least two dangling ports each while their projected q relation is ALL_EQ_3 or an equivalent variable-consistency relation sufficient to connect the v8.2 OR_3 clause atom. Track exact (c,s,q) witnesses and H-path topology. Start with four wires and use the seven-edge witness as a seed to move saturation onto hidden wires. If bounded auxiliary search fails, extract a cut/port-flow invariant rather than extrapolating from finite failure.
